holdout: 40 published maps in map-split.json x 9 local reference styles x both sides; opened once for the single selected candidate and the incumbent; plus direct candidate-vs-hp01 on the 40 holdout maps, both sides
selection: all tuning/selection on the 88 dev maps only; exactly one candidate is taken to the holdout

gates.G1_targets: release builds: Homonoliths median first home-group capture <= 600 with score >= hp01; Islands quiet trailing stall pairs <= 0.75 x hp01 with score >= hp01
gates.G2_build_faults: clean release build from recorded source digest; zero candidate bot faults in every holdout game
gates.G3_fuel: candidate fuel exhaustion events per game <= 1.2 x hp01 + 0.05 on holdout
gates.G4_strength: holdout reference score: candidate - hp01 >= 0 points (paired) and map-cluster bootstrap 10th percentile of paired difference >= -2.0 percentage points
gates.G5_direct: direct candidate vs hp01 on holdout >= 50%
gates.G6_inspection: report 5 worst maps and worst opponent by paired difference; any map losing >= 6 of 18 paired games needs a written explanation

ladder: ladder evidence reported separately; no ladder data used for local gates
